Previously frozen bytes are unchanged. Let p=6m+1>=7. The independent V=M mod p=f_p mod p has degree exactly m and satisfies D_G V=0. The independent reverse C has degree <=3m-1 and satisfies D_C C=-[(1-w)^(3m)-1]/(9w). For a=w(1-w), b=1-3w/2, c=-1/18, the formal flat-dw adjoint is (a d^2+b d+c)^*=a d^2+(2a'-b)d+(a''-b'+c). Its derivative coefficient is 1-5w/2 and its constant is -5/9, exactly D_C. For the concomitant K=a(CV'-VC')+(b-a')VC =w(1-w)(CV'-VC')+(w/2)VC, expanding its derivative gives coefficients b on CV', b-2a' on VC' and b'-a'' on VC. Thus K'=C D_G V-V D_C C, with the displayed signs. Consequently K'=(1/9)V[(1-w)^(3m)-1]/w, K(0)=0. Both quotients here are polynomials; no punctured-domain division is used.
